newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy gives Warta buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy gives Warta buy recommendation.

text.p: The brokerage unit of Poland's Bank Handlowy SA rated insurance firm TUiR Warta SA as a buy, stressing its improved financial results and strong market position.

Bank Handlowy said in a report dated September 20 and released on Monday that unlike many other Polish insurers, Warta's net reserves were fully covered by investments and its ratio of technical reserves was higher than the sector's.

"Taking into account the good prospects for the development of insurance services in Poland as well as the forecast improvement in financial results, we recommend to investors with a medium-term investment horizon to buy the company's shares," it said.
Handlowy saw Warta's net profit growing to 28.5 million zlotys in 1996 and to 35.3 million in 1997 from 13.7 million last year.
It expected Warta's gross premium to rise to 746.4 million zlotys this year and to 858.4 million next year from 654.8 million in 1995.
